meta.name: cyberedge-assess-scope
meta.description: Run one complete, evidence-backed CyberEdge assessment workflow for an explicitly authorized Scope. Use when an AI operator must check runtime readiness, expand domain assets, inventory services and websites, run bounded vulnerability and intelligence stages, follow one Task, and report exact stage coverage without claiming unavailable adapters were completed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对授权目标执行完整的安全评估工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化执行授权范围内的资产发现、漏洞扫描与报告生成
copy.tagline_en: Run a complete security assessment workflow for authorized targets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate asset discovery, vulnerability scanning, and reporting within authorized scope

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 可以为已明确授权的网络资产范围运行一次完整的 CyberEdge 安全评估，包括检查运行时准备状态、扩展域名资产、盘点服务和网站、执行漏洞与情报扫描，跟踪单个任务并报告各阶段的完成情况。
howto.when: 当用户提供一个已授权范围（scope_id）并需要进行一次完整的 CyberEdge 安全评估时触发。需要先确认该范围存在且包含授权证明。

say.text: 对已授权的 scope ID 执行一次标准 CyberEdge 评估。
say.note: 发起一次常规盘点评估，使用服务端默认端口。

say.text: 请对刚刚授权的网络范围进行 CyberEdge 全面扫描。
报告当前 scope ID 的评估覆盖状态。
say.note: 获取评估报告，查看各阶段（完整、部分、不可用等）状态。

howto.what_en: Claude runs one complete, evidence-backed CyberEdge assessment for an authorized scope: checks readiness, expands domain assets, inventories services and websites, runs bounded vulnerability and intelligence stages, follows a single task, and reports exact stage coverage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a scope with a valid authorization_ref exists and a full CyberEdge assessment is requested. The workflow requires an existing scope_id and a non-empty authorization_ref.

say_en.text: Run a standard CyberEdge assessment on the authorized scope ID.
say_en.note: Starts a routine inventory assessment with server-default ports.

say_en.text: Perform a thorough CyberEdge scan on the recently authorized scope.
Report the assessment coverage status for the current scope ID.
